newsitem.title: UK: IPE November Brent crude hits contract highs.
newsitem.headline: IPE November Brent crude hits contract highs.

text.p: IPE November Brent crude oil hit contract highs in a market led mainly by NYMEX crude and gasoline.
November Brent broke through the contract high of $24.50 made on Monday to hit Tuesday's high of $24.66 a barrel.
"There's no fresh news out there. It wasn't much of a problem breaking through the high ($24.50) once the NYMEX led the way," one broker said.
November Brent traded up 14 cents at $24.63 by 1822 GMT.
Brokers saw upside resistance on the contract at $25.00 a barrel.
A strong European fundamental market was still supportive to further gains on outright levels, brokers said.
